1.description:

22.title: Mikulski Calls on Senate to Fund DHS and Support Local First Responders
22.description: On Tuesday, February 24, 2015, U.S. Senator Barbara A. Mikulski (D-Md.), Vice Chairwoman of the Senate Appropriations Committee, joined Senate Democratic Leader Harry Reid (D- Nev.), Senator Jeanne Shaheen (D-N.H.), Ranking Member of the Senate Appropriations Subcommittee on the Department of Homeland Security, other members of the Senate Democratic Caucus and local first responders to urge Republicans to quit playing politics with our national security and to support a clean bill to fund the Department of Homeland Security. Senate Democrats highlighted how a Republican-manufactured shutdown of the Department of Homeland Security would negatively impact the ability of local authorities to respond to emergencies in communities throughout the country.

69.title: Chairwoman Mikulski & Senate Women with Pay Equity Activist Lilly Ledbetter
69.description:
On Tuesday, January 28, 2014 U.S. Senator Barbara A. Mikulski (D-Md.), Dean of the Senate women, along with Senate women colleagues held a photo-op with pay equity activist Lilly Ledbetter in the historic Senate Appropriations Committee Room.

Senator Mikulski led the floor fight for Senate passage of the Fair Pay Act in 2009, which is named after Lilly Ledbetter who along with the Senate women has fought for equal pay for equal work. Senator Mikulski and Congresswoman DeLauro have introduced the Paycheck Fairness Act, legislation that would build on the promise of the Lilly Ledbetter Fair Pay Act and help close the wage gap between women and men working equivalent jobs.
